Proved integration-candidate implementation dispatch — #346, 2026-11-03.

Published clean coordinator b44594962a0996a3ce7f58ecd64f0b9079843af4 supplies docs/reviews/briefs/m6-integration-candidate.md v2, SHA256 3a3c65660b0730ca2f45539b8a2d27a8bdfbcc1e69843bc19c72f88ef8d426a5. Read the FULL brief at that exact commit and this FULL comment before executing. P1's stranger proof6608470639/report2f1733f701edf52de58dd704b981de7c237867a87bd63461d6a6f0c91dd99dd4 returned three concrete omissions; root supplied the exact probe program/receipt paths, all four named tool additions and explicit M7 recipe/unpack routes. Root read the actual conflicting tool row and inline unpack implementation. Original v1 bytes are recovered against the original input hash and labelled accordingly; original proof/failed attempts remain retained. No implementation is pre-approved by this handoff proof.

This explicitly dispatches the four named v2 implementation tasks:
- T1 wN:p4: exact one-file fork-tool-list resolver and its new refusal/positive controls; private candidate only.
- T2 wN:p5: construct the exact common001–028 M7 ES comparison baseline in a NEW private bare store/index, with strict application receipts or the first concrete failure. Preserve full recipe/hooks and separate architecture overlay; no M6 tip merge or ES pin choice.
- T3 wN:p6: private whole-entry shared-record reconciliation helper; preserve both histories/order, return partial files and exact unresolved collisions, leave INDEX for root regeneration.
- T5 wN:p7: generic ordered private merge driver plus new tiny-Git controls, including conflict stop and exact-parent resume; NO real M6/M7/ES candidate execution by this worker.

P1 has completed this proof and remains available for a later bounded implementation readback; no new task is implied here. Do not invent work to fill a pane.

Each executor uses its own newly created /workspace/tmp/m6-<lane>-integration-20261103-* directory, after fresh df -B1/df -i, CPUs8–23. Small metadata may be in /tmp; source or simulated Git trees may not. No shared worktree/ref/index/kit/tracker writes, source fixes, old producer/test/audit replay, held/proof-root/cache inspection, cleanup, runtime/provider/device/cloud action or other-agent permission answer. Only the new private construction/fixtures expressly named in v2 are authorized. Preserve genuine failures and exact code/input/output identities. Return one complete bounded deliverable or concrete blocker to wN:p2 and stop; no worker waits on another worker.

Root owns all choices, actual serial integration, installation of candidate bytes, acceptance and runtime. The initial M7+coordinator merge-tree probe remains unresolved exit1/13 conflicts before46 endpoints; source candidate preparation is now progressing to concrete helpers and baseline construction. M7 retains live next/checkpoint ownership and pending Nova reboot permission. Its41b528 input is immutable comparison context; no new handover, live roll-up, build or physical action is granted. D-WORKFLOW-191 build selection remains open. No slice or issue closes from this dispatch.

Can this be done on the VM? These new Git/text construction and refusal checks do not claim image/runtime behavior and need no VM allocation.
